statement: All four Metal knobs in the #162 table are value-parsed, not presence-based: each reads its env var through a helper that treats the literal "0" as off and any other non-empty value as on. The four knobs use three helpers, enumerated per knob: session-union and stream-overlap read through metal_graph_tp_env_flag (ds4.c:72007, 71923/71925), IQ2 grouped-MM reads through ds4_gpu_env_bool (ds4_metal.m:50582), and exact-rows-persistent reads through ds4_gpu_exact_rows_persistent_env_enabled (ds4_metal.m:14837). The three REQUIRE spellings (session-union, IQ2 grouped-MM, exact-rows-persistent) fail closed with an error print when ineligible, but there is NO positive admission print -- no Metal analogue of CUDA's `target_admitted=1`. The admission concept in the Metal sources is internal state (a `bool admitted` field, `state->admitted = true`, the `g_q4_qb_transient_f16_admission` struct), not a print. The only admission signal is the absence of the fail-closed error. Q4_STREAM_OVERLAP has no REQUIRE spelling at all; it is a soft opt-in via ENABLE/DISABLE only. This matters because a presence-based knob would let an 'off' arm silently run on (the adamlawi 0.0% trap); these are all value-parsed, so '0' genuinely disables.

claims.statement: DS4_METAL_REQUIRE_Q4_SSD_SESSION_UNION is read via metal_graph_tp_env_flag (ds4.c:72006-72007), which returns dflt when unset/empty and `strcmp(env, "0") != 0` otherwise -- the literal "0" disables, any other non-empty value enables.
claims.falsifier: If DS4_METAL_REQUIRE_Q4_SSD_SESSION_UNION is read with a bare getenv() presence check (no value comparison), then this knob is presence-based and the value-parsed claim collapses for it.

claims.statement: DS4_METAL_ENABLE_Q4_STREAM_OVERLAP and DS4_METAL_DISABLE_Q4_STREAM_OVERLAP are read via metal_graph_tp_env_flag (ds4.c:71922-71925), which returns dflt when unset/empty and `strcmp(env, "0") != 0` otherwise -- the literal "0" disables, any other non-empty value enables.
claims.falsifier: If either stream-overlap env var is read with a bare getenv() presence check (no value comparison), then this knob is presence-based and the value-parsed claim collapses for it.

claims.statement: DS4_METAL_REQUIRE_IQ2_XXS_SSD_PREFILL_MM is read via ds4_gpu_env_bool (ds4_metal.m:50582), which returns -1 when unset, 1 for 1/true/yes/on, 0 for 0/false/no/off, and treats an unrecognized value as presence-enabled with a warning -- the literal "0" disables.
claims.falsifier: If DS4_METAL_REQUIRE_IQ2_XXS_SSD_PREFILL_MM is read with a bare getenv() presence check (no value comparison), then this knob is presence-based and the value-parsed claim collapses for it.

claims.statement: DS4_METAL_REQUIRE_EXACT_ROWS_PERSISTENT_CACHE is read via ds4_gpu_exact_rows_persistent_env_enabled (ds4_metal.m:14836-14837), which returns `value && value[0] && strcmp(value, "0") != 0` -- the literal "0" disables, any other non-empty value enables.
claims.falsifier: If DS4_METAL_REQUIRE_EXACT_ROWS_PERSISTENT_CACHE is read with a bare getenv() presence check (no value comparison), then this knob is presence-based and the value-parsed claim collapses for it.

claims.statement: The admission concept in the Metal sources is internal state, not a print: grep for 'admitted' in ds4_metal.m finds `bool admitted` (907), `state->admitted = true` (971), and the `g_q4_qb_transient_f16_admission` struct (908-910) -- all on the transient-f16 path, none a fprintf/printf/ds4_log. The REQUIRE spellings print only on failure (fail-closed); there is no positive print that reports a REQUIRE path being selected. The only admission signal is the absence of the fail-closed error.
claims.falsifier: If a positive admission print exists (a fprintf/printf/ds4_log that fires when a REQUIRE path is selected), then the 'no admission print' claim collapses and the peer must use that string instead of the absence-of-error signal.

claims.statement: The three REQUIRE spellings fail closed with these exact error strings: session-union at ds4.c:73983-73988 'required Metal Q4 SSD session union is ineligible (need 2..5 valid sessions, AProjQ4 + routed IQ2_XXS/Q2_K, static decode map, and >= rows*6 cached experts)'; IQ2 grouped-MM at ds4_metal.m:50664-50669 'ds4: required Metal IQ2_XXS SSD grouped address-MM path was not selected tokens=%u gate=%u down=%u'; exact-rows-persistent at ds4_metal.m:20449-20453 'ds4: Metal exact-row persistent cache is required but disabled or ineligible (cache_budget=%u size_class_budget=%u unique=%u)'.
argv: required Metal Q4 SSD session union is ineligible

expect.stdout_contains: required Metal Q4 SSD session union is ineligible

observed.stdout: 73983:                     "required Metal Q4 SSD session union is ineligible "

claims.falsifier: If the REQUIRE spellings do not print these fail-closed errors (or print different text), the error-string claim collapses and the peer cannot rely on them as the admission signal.

claims.statement: Q4_STREAM_OVERLAP has no REQUIRE spelling: ds4_q4_stream_overlap_policy (ds4.c:71917) reads only DS4_METAL_ENABLE_Q4_STREAM_OVERLAP and DS4_METAL_DISABLE_Q4_STREAM_OVERLAP via metal_graph_tp_env_flag, both defaulting false. It is a soft opt-in with no fail-closed arm.
claims.falsifier: If a DS4_METAL_REQUIRE_Q4_STREAM_OVERLAP spelling exists, then stream-overlap does have a REQUIRE arm and the 'no REQUIRE' claim collapses.
